description: Run an ADA / WCAG 2.1 AA accessibility audit (axe-core). Paid plans only. Returns the compliance score and grade, lawsuit risk (high/medium/low/minimal), category breakdowns, violations (WCAG 2.1 AA failures with affected elements and a plain-English fix), best_practices (not WCAG requirements; they never lower the score), needs_review and priorities. ADA audits have their own monthly allowance, separate from the audit quota (the usage tool reports ada_remaining). Each key may run 2 at a time; a 429 is not counted.

include_trackers.description: Also add the tracker and pixel inventory to the report.

url.description: The URL to audit. Must include the protocol (https://...).

name: accessibility_audit
